notes: Account: mid-to-large support org (45k tickets/month). Heavy seasonal spikes — holiday windows and product launches cause 3x traffic for 72-96 hrs.
Primary ask: deploy agent-assist + automated ticket summarization that surfaces exact article citations; minimize hallucinations and provide per-suggestion source links.

Requirements: RAG pipeline across multiple internal sources (Zendesk articles, Confluence, S3 dumps of KB PDFs, Postgres product DB). Freshness requirement: <24h for KB sync; incremental syncs preferred.

Latency / throughput: live assist p95 retrieval+response <400ms for short queries; expected steady-state 60 qps with spikes to 180 qps. Must support graceful degradation to cached responses during spikes.
Quality metrics for POC: citation precision >=85%, summary compression ratio ~6x, human accept rate >=90% on agent assist suggestions.
Model preferences: open to Llama/Redwood-verified variants; require quantization options for Dedicated; prefer ability to pin model versions for rollouts.
Security: must integrate with Okta SSO, central KMS (AWS KMS/HSM), audit logs forwarded to SIEM, and retention controls per EU/NA residency. Air-gapped option considered for regulated clients.
Cost sensitivity: care about unit economics of retrieval + generation; want Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and KV cache to reduce token cost during high-throughput windows.
Quote from Head of Support: 'Citations are non-negotiable — agents need traceable answers for compliance.'
Integration asks: tool-calling to create/update Zendesk tickets, attach AI-generated summaries, and surface suggested macros in agent UI; rollback if confidence <0.6.
Fallback strategy discussed: primary = dedicated model + live retriever; fallback = cached FAQ answers + downgraded model in other region; automatic A/B rollback on regressions.
Competitor checks: evaluating Zendesk's AI add-on, Intercom recommendations, but they lack enterprise routing/fallback and quantization controls we need.
POC success measurement: week-by-week dashboard (cost per resolved ticket, avg handle time reduction, citation precision, API latency percentiles).
Open legal questions: contractual clause for ephemeral KV cache retention and deletion confirmation; data residency wording for customer-submitted attachments.
summary: Northbridge is an enterprise CX platform evaluating Redwood Dedicated/Private for a RAG-powered agent-assist and ticket summarization POC. Key priorities: citation fidelity, 24h freshness, predictable scaling through spikes, SSO/KMS compliance, and cost controls via batching/cache. POC planned for April pending NDA and legal sign-off.
